scientific_question: Given only information known at daily decision time t, does the frozen continuous funding-pressure ECDF percentile add predictive information for subsequent market-wide RV24 beyond a fixed compact HAR-RV persistence baseline?
claim_boundary: A PASS can establish only exploratory incremental predictive information within a prior-exposed historical follow-up. It cannot establish causality, inverse funding effects, economic significance, trading edge, State Observer promotion, Router authority, Qnty authority, or trading authority.

parent_binding.historical_primary_proposition: mean(RV24 | HIGH funding pressure) - mean(RV24 | LOW funding pressure) > 0

feature_contract.formula: pressure_t = median_i(abs(latest_known_settlement_rate_i)); percentile_t = count(v <= pressure_t) / count(v) over the prior 365 daily pressure observations plus current pressure_t
feature_contract.settlement_semantics: Exact source funding_time_ms; finalized event known at funding_time_ms; latest eligible event satisfies funding_time <= t and t - 24h < funding_time.
feature_contract.aggregation: MEDIAN(abs(funding_rate)) across the exact frozen 20-member panel
feature_contract.normalization: 365 prior daily observations plus current observation; inclusive <= ECDF; percentile is a fraction in [0,1]

outcome_contract.timestamp_alignment: Feature information is known through t; outcome uses exactly the next 24 completed hourly intervals after t.

A.name: EXPLORATORY_610_INCREMENTAL_FORECAST_TEST
pros: answers whether the feature adds information beyond persistence
cons: historical outcomes and the old aggregate result are already exposed
cannot support independent confirmation or sealed-evaluation claims

B.name: DEVELOPMENT_610_PLUS_DISJOINT_SEALED_EVALUATION
reasons: REEF funding lifecycle terminates within the later candidate period
no later 20-member funding and OHLCV input is Git-bound
later panel continuity and warm-up cannot be certified without new acquisition
current-listing substitution and survivor selection are prohibited

C.name: DEVELOPMENT_610_PLUS_PROSPECTIVE_EVALUATION
reasons: requires a new long-lived funding recorder
JH01 V1 is a separate ARMED_BUT_INACTIVE prospective campaign
waiting for or operating alongside JH01 does not justify duplicating a long prospective calendar burden in this phase

D.name: KILL_FUNDING_INCREMENTAL_LINE
D.reason: A can answer the narrow exploratory question without disguising prior exposure as confirmation; a design kill is not warranted before that bounded discriminator exists.

selected_architecture.classification_rule: A retrospective causal rolling forecast is exploratory because the historical outcomes and old aggregate funding result were already exposed; it is not outcome-unseen, sealed, unseen, or prospective evidence.

evaluation_contract.feature_warmup: At least 30 complete prior daily RV24 values for the monthly HAR component; no post-freeze warm-up adjustment.
evaluation_contract.feature_cutoff: All funding and OHLCV inputs have safe-known timestamps <= t; no future or partial bar is allowed.

primary_test.adjusted_difference: d_t = e0_t^2 - e1_t^2 + (f0_t - f1_t)^2; positive favors M1

testing_contract.multiple_testing: ONE_PRIMARY_COMPARISON_AND_ONE_PRIMARY_LOSS; BASELINE_0 IS CONTEXT ONLY AND HAS NO RESCUE AUTHORITY
testing_contract.materiality_reason: No deployment, capital, or action-utility context supplies an independent practical threshold for this prior-exposed exploratory discriminator. Report relative MSE improvement descriptively; do not call it material, economic, or actionable.

pass_fail.pass_condition: Valid 244-origin evaluation; MSE_M1 < MSE_M0; and one-sided Clark-West adjusted-MSPE HAC p <= 0.05. Because MATERIALITY_GATE is NONE_JUSTIFIABLE, PASS is limited to exploratory incremental predictive information and is not a materiality or action-utility claim.
pass_fail.fail_condition: FUNDING_PRESSURE_INCREMENTAL_VALUE_NOT_ESTABLISHED if any valid primary direction or statistical gate fails; failure ends this funding-pressure incremental-value lineage with no within-lineage rescue.
pass_fail.blocked_condition: BLOCKED if source, panel, timing, point-in-time, missingness, digest, or execution-boundary integrity fails before a valid evaluation.
pass_fail.future_new_hypothesis_boundary: Signed funding, inverse direction, new ECDF thresholds, shocks, acceleration, basis, open interest, liquidations, alternate horizons, alternate RV estimators, subsets, or later-period selection require separate hypotheses and separate preregistration.

contamination_contract.panel_survivorship_risk: PRESERVED_AND_EXPLICIT; frozen 20-member panel only, no later substitution or survivor conditioning

ten_stack.SOCRATIC: This tests whether funding adds information beyond volatility persistence; the old HIGH-minus-LOW contrast did not test that question.
ten_stack.DIALECTIC: Continue because a null directional contrast can coexist with conditional forecast content; stop because the old result lowers the prior and the new sample is outcome-exposed. A is retained only as a bounded exploratory discriminator.
ten_stack.POPPER: Funding is not established as an incremental RV-state variable if M1 fails to lower MSE or fails the one-sided adjusted-MSPE HAC gate.
ten_stack.CAUSAL: Any positive result remains predictive association/incremental forecast evidence; it does not identify a causal funding effect.
ten_stack.SYSTEMS: A PASS could make funding a stronger upstream State Observer candidate, but no observer implementation or Router construction is authorized by this contract.
ten_stack.CYBERNETICS: The test reduces uncertainty relevant to later state selection only at the feature-qualification layer; it does not authorize a feedback controller or action.
ten_stack.BAYESIAN: The negative HIGH-minus-LOW contrast reduces the prior probability of a simple monotone funding-volatility story, so only a distinct incremental forecast result can update the funding line.
ten_stack.MDL: One continuous ECDF percentile is the compact retained representation; adding transforms or bins would increase degrees of freedom without a new mechanism.
ten_stack.DOE: A has the highest information gain per cost among the four admissible options because B is not feasibility-certified, C duplicates JH01-scale prospective burden, and D discards a bounded discriminator.
ten_stack.ADVERSARIAL: Positive results must not be manufactured by reversing sign, using old outcomes as pristine confirmation, weakening the baseline, shopping lags/transforms/thresholds, changing the panel, or claiming causality/action utility.

qntyagenteval.basis: Canonical project context reports QntyAgentEval adapter not implemented; no compatible frozen evaluator contract exists for this static preregistration.
